from pyspark.sql.functions import col, expr , sequence, to_date, lit, year, month, dayofmonth, date_format, quarter, explode

path_dim_data = "abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/dim_data/"

# Criar a coluna data_comp
df_datas_base = spark.range(1).select(
    explode(sequence(to_date(lit("2026-01-01")),to_date(lit("2046-12-31")), expr("interval 1 day"))).alias("data_comp")
)


df_dim_data = (
    df_datas_base
    .withColumn("sk_data", date_format(col("data_comp"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("ano",year(col("data_comp")))
    .withColumn("mes",month(col("data_comp")))
    .withColumn("dia",dayofmonth(col("data_comp")))
    .withColumn("nome_mes",date_format(col("data_comp"),"MMMM"))
    .withColumn("nome_dia",date_format(col("data_comp"),"EEEE"))
    .withColumn("trimestre",quarter(col("data_comp")))
    .select("sk_data","data_comp","ano","mes","dia","nome_mes","nome_dia","trimestre")
)

spark.sql("create database if not exists gold")

(df_dim_data.write
.format("delta")
.mode("overwrite")
.option("path",f"{path_dim_data}/dim_data")
.saveAsTable("gold.dim_data")
)
